title: Conditions of Hire: Cancelling a Confirmed Rental on the Car Rental Rate Classes
content:
**1. Whose act it is.** On every one of the Car Rental Rate Classes, only the renter may cancel their own confirmed rental, and the cancellation is confirmed by the renter rather than performed on their behalf.

**2. The free window.** A cancellation is handled free of charge only when frozen time is not after the moment the supplier confirmed the renter's booking plus the free-cancellation term of the rate class booked. The free-cancellation term is counted in whole elapsed hours from the confirmation moment, never mixing elapsed hours with calendar days, and a cancellation confirmed exactly at the boundary is still free.

**3. Inside the window.** Inside the free-cancellation term nothing is withheld on any rate class and the prepayment is returned in full.

**4. A clause no longer in force.** The following sentence of these conditions has been superseded by the current basis and is no longer in force: "Outside it the charge is read off the rate class's cancellation ladder by how many whole days lie between the cancellation and the scheduled collection; where the ladder yields nothing the class's flat cancellation charge applies instead, and the two are never added." It is recorded here so that it is not applied.

**5. Clauses standing beside it.** A class that returns nothing withholds the whole prepayment, and the agency service fee is not returned on any class. A cancellation made because the supplier itself cannot provide the vehicle is free on every class, whatever the ladder says. A cancellation after the scheduled collection time has passed is not a cancellation but a no-show, and the no-show terms apply instead.

**The free window, counted.** The clock starts at the moment the supplier confirmed the renter's booking, as that moment stands on the rental record, and runs forward by the number of hours the class publishes. The comparison is made against frozen time and is a not-after comparison: frozen time at or before the boundary is inside the window, and only frozen time later than the boundary is outside it. The term is elapsed hours throughout, and elapsed hours are never converted into or mixed with calendar days.

**Two boundary cases on hypothetical moments.** Take a confirmed rental on a class publishing a 24-hour free-cancellation term. Where the supplier confirmed at a given moment and the renter confirms the cancellation exactly 24 elapsed hours later, the cancellation is inside the window and free, because equality at the boundary satisfies the test. Where the renter confirms it 25 elapsed hours after confirmation, the cancellation falls outside the window. On a class publishing 0 free-cancellation hours, no elapsed time at all can be inside the window once confirmation has passed.

**The evidence the test rests on.** The moment of the supplier's confirmation, the rental's own reference and its scheduled collection moment are taken from the rental record rather than from what the renter recalls, and they are read before the cancellation is handled.

superseded_clauses: Outside it the charge is read off the rate class's cancellation ladder by how many whole days lie between the cancellation and the scheduled collection; where the ladder yields nothing the class's flat cancellation charge applies instead, and the two are never added.
